'''Ion Focusing Coils''' were a type of weapon component. The [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer]] incorporated several Ion Focusing Coils in its design where they were part of the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], located between the [[Discharge Nozzle]]s and the main bulk of the device.<ref name="EGWT" />
